name: Long Range Dual Motor Performance Pack

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Polestar US page: 111 kWh battery on all trims (does not say gross/usable); BatteryDesign.net and Motor1 give 111 total / 107 usable for this SPA2 pack. Estimated: the Polestar US spec page states no model year; US page and the catalogue trim names (unchanged Long Range trims) point to the 400 V 111 kWh car for US/CA 2026, but the 800 V refresh is reported (InsideEVs; US availability not announced) and Polestar Canada now lists it. Hardware for 2026 is unproven; this entry is the US-page car.

Canada page (preliminary, no model year; trims Dual motor and Performance, not the catalogue Long Range names): 106 kWh pack, 16 modules. Entry for the 800 V car; the CA/US split needs variants, not done here.
